findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and placeholder anomalies in platform-runtime

evidence.observation: Hardcoded empty list with TODO: Query quality_anomalies table
Multiple TODO comments for Phase 5 authorization, memory integration, and core implementation

proposed_action.description: Implement database querying for quality anomalies and complete Phase 5 authorization and memory integration logic in research commands.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents degraded functionality and incomplete business logic in runtime forecasting and research execution.

findings.title: Missing Model Router call log file

evidence.observation: call_log_exists is false and call_log_size_mb is null for configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Verify directory permissions and ensure model-router initializes and writes request telemetry to call_log.jsonl.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model invocations, latency, and routing failures across core services.

findings.title: Direct LLM API client invocations bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct call_gemini and call_mistral invocations using environment API keys rather than routing via model router port 8891

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to query the centralized model-router endpoint instead of invoking provider SDKs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized model governance, rate limiting, and observability for intelligence alerts.
